mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0 in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during confirmed inflation spikes.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeds historical averages, signaling labor market strength that supports equity valuations and drives positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or flat despite sustained PAYEMS above threshold (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive month of rising HOUST industrial production signals strengthening demand momentum, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST 3-month moving average exceeds previous month's value
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative when demand momentum persists but SPX underperforms (Rank IC < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO supply index below 100 suggests supply-side pressures, which tends to depress equities and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are consistently positive during INDPRO contraction (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains above 4% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 exhibits higher 60-day forward returns due to expectations of persistent higher interest rates compressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than average during high-rate periods (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 3.5% after a prolonged rise indicates cooling labor market pressures, which is associated with negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their 12-month averages jointly predict positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns through enhanced consumer and business confidence.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive when both proxies exceed thresholds (Rank IC < -0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in both INDPRO and GDPC1 for three consecutive months signals structural supply constraints, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns in the recovery phase.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO 3mo avg < 100 AND GDPC1 3mo avg < 12mo avg
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive during the identified supply contraction (p < 0.05).
